ir.name: pairwise_contrastive_ranking_advantage_weighted_exp_loss
ir.intuition: Shift from margin-based losses to a contrastive ranking loss paradigm. This loss computes a normalized exponentiated negative scaled difference between log probabilities weighted by the advantage gap, emphasizing ranking consistency. Rather than using margin or sigmoid-style links, it uses an exponential decay to penalize violations softly and aggregates by weighted mean. The constraint enforces normalization by the mean absolute advantage to maintain scale invariance while focusing on ranking quality via contrastive weighting.
ir.pseudocode:
norm_adv = max(mean(abs(advantage_gap)), epsilon)
diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm_adv
scaled_diff = alpha * diff
loss_terms = exp(-scaled_diff) * weight * abs(advantage_gap)
return mean(loss_terms)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    epsilon = 1e-6
    norm_adv = ops.maximum(ops.mean(ops.abs(advantage_gap)), epsilon)
    diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_adv)
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(alpha, diff)
    base_loss = ops.exp(ops.neg(scaled_diff))
    weighted_loss = base_loss
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, ops.abs(advantage_gap))
    if weight is not None:
        weighted_loss = ops.mul(weighted_loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
